My Life as a Computer Technology Student

Publication Date: August 28, 2026  |  Author: Cyrene Rellin

Learning Web Development

Learning web development helps me understand how a website is structured, styled, and presented on different devices. HTML gives the page meaning, while CSS makes the design organized, readable, and responsive.

  • Build clear and organized HTML structures.
  • Use CSS Flexbox and Grid for layouts.
  • Make pages comfortable to view on mobile devices.

Why Responsive Design Matters

A responsive website should remain useful and easy to read whether it is opened on a phone, tablet, laptop, or desktop. Media queries can adjust the layout, typography, and spacing according to the screen size.

Images should resize proportionally so they do not overflow their containers. Non-essential elements can also be hidden or rearranged on smaller screens to keep the main content easy to focus on.

My Goals in Web Development

I want to improve my skills by practicing accessible, semantic, and responsive websites. Good comments and a consistent structure also make code easier to understand and maintain, especially when working on larger projects.

  • Improve my HTML and CSS skills.
  • Create accessible pages for different users.
  • Practice responsive layouts and clean code.
